title: myrospermum peruiferum
intro: Myrospermum peruiferum, commonly known as the Myrobalan Plum or Hog Plum, is a plant species belonging to the family Anacardiaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which can help to protect against various diseases and promote overall well-being.
